description: Sign up for a 30-day Free Trial and get access to this and 20+ ZoomCharts visuals.Drill Down Shape Map PRO (Filter) is a powerful tool used by 80% of Fortune 200 companies. It allows you to visualize location data on maps that are easy and intuitive to explore on any device. Explore data by country, city, or use the lasso tool to create storable filters for custom regions. Add donut charts on top of the map to visualize clusters of data. Pick from available shape layers and use rich formatting options to style data. Drill Down Shape Map PRO (Filter) also provides touch-driven interactions and smooth animations, making data exploration quick, easy, and fun. MAIN FEATURES: Multiple shape layers – world, USA, United Kingdom and Australia Filtering by shapes – use built-in shape layers (e.g. countries, states) or custom shapes (the lasso tool) to filter data in the respective regions Storable custom shapes – as a report creator, create and save custom filters and pass them to the end-users Clustering – group data in clusters based on their location and proximity Cross-chart filtering – select data points on multiple charts instead of using slicers Multi-page tooltips for clustered nodes – browse information for all related nodes within one tooltip Clusters as donut charts – turn clusters into donut charts to visualize the content of the cluster; slices will act as category filters…
